title-art: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original full-bleed title-screen key art for BEAST BRAWL, a 2D fantasy creature arcade fighter. Create a widescreen 16:9 illustrated game cover, inspired by expressive early-2000s hand-inked action-adventure box art. Large lively original creature lineup clustered in the LEFT 55%: a red-orange young horned dragon with fingerless leather boxing gloves and cream chest, a yellow lightning-eared alley cat with navy scarf and blue boxing wraps, a cyan coral-armored crab with oversized armored pincers, a lilac cosmic serpent, and a blue-white long-eared ice rabbit fighter in a burgundy scarf. Dynamic three-quarter poses, distinct silhouettes, expressive confident faces, colored dark ink outlines, cel-shaded painted detail. Behind them is an atmospheric teal emerald forest with enormous ancient trees, hanging leaves, ruined stone arches, blue mountains and shafts of light. The RIGHT 45% should have darker quieter forest and mist for readable overlaid game logo and menu. Saturated colors with controlled dark shadows and golden rim light. Attractive professional 2D game key art, a cohesive composition, no UI cards, no existing characters, no photorealism, no 3D, no voxel, no fake embossed lettering, NO TEXT OR LOGOS anywhere. Keep all important creatures inside the central 85% so cropping is safe.
fighters-ember-tide: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset for an original 2D pixel-art creature fighting game. Create ONE square 1024x1024 PNG sprite atlas with a truly transparent background. EXACTLY FOUR rows by FOUR columns, all cells 256x256 pixels, invisible grid. Each row is one distinct creature and each column is its pose: column 1 idle combat stance facing right, column 2 lunging melee attack facing right with extended striking limb, column 3 getting hit/recoiling facing right, column 4 defeated lying on ground. Each individual sprite fits inside its cell with at least 20px transparent padding; feet baseline at 230px within every cell. Do not spill between cells. Consistent character identity and scale through each row. Detailed authentic 64x64-era pixel art enlarged 4x using nearest-neighbor only, crisp stepped edges, sophisticated 12-18 color ramps per creature, warm highlights and cool shade, dark colored outlines, selective dithering and small texture clusters. Appealing expressive faces, anatomy and fighting gear, NOT tiny 16x16 icons, NOT 3D, NOT voxels, NOT smooth vector art, NOT glossy AI figurines. Strong silhouette and attractive action poses, comparable to polished GBA/DS action RPG combat sprites. No labels, no text, no background scenery, no grid lines, no shadows outside sprite. Original creatures only. Row 1 ASHFANG: stocky small red-orange horned dragon, cream plated belly, crimson wing membranes, ivory horns, leather fingerless boxing gloves, scale clusters and claws. Row 2 KILNBACK: squat walking terracotta furnace tortoise, large layered dark red ceramic shell, glowing amber furnace grille, brass rings and forepaw gauntlets, little face beneath shell. Row 3 REEFCLAW: cyan/turquoise coral-armored crab fighter, two large asymmetrical navy-braced pincers, multiple legs, ivory shell ridges, expressive amber eye stalks. Row 4 INKVEIL: blue-indigo octopus brawler with six curling tentacle legs, light cyan suction cups, brow markings and burgundy fighting cuffs. Make all four clearly non-human original monsters.
